summary: Query Credit Karma (creditkarma.com) transactions from a shell with the fpx CLI (@fetchproxy/cli) instead of running the creditkarma-mcp server — capture the signed-in session cookie once, then curl the GraphQL transactions endpoint directly. Use when you want Credit Karma transaction data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.
